title: Thief stole cash, now wants bananas 🍌 | Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony | English Cartoon Comedy
description:
A mysterious thief is gobbling up the money in the house, and nobody can figure out who it is. The phone game bill has grown bigger than the monthly salary, and the whole colony gang rushes in to investigate. Every clue leads to a pile of bananas and a suspect who is far too fond of them. Watch the gang chase the truth with plenty of laughs, panic and chaotic detective work. Lesson: a game that asks for money every few minutes is not really your friend, so read the bill before it reads you. Subscribe to Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony for a new episode every week!
